Expected.description: One required or advisory suite case, with its former/expected filename.

case_id.description: Stable producer case ID, separate from a filename.

required.description: Whether absence prevents complete required coverage.

Supplied.description: Outcome recorded by a capture producer, including unsuccessful attempts.

capture_sha256.description: Hash of actual encoded capture; required for compared coverage.

entry.description: Actual comparison entry name; None if no image was produced.

state.description: captured, skipped, quarantined, stale, missing or unusable.

description: Expected suite and every attempted/supplied capture.

supplied.description: Capture attempts; duplicate identities are retained as coverage failures.
